brief:
The Palestinian Authority in Ramallah purchased employee debts from Gaza for $984.6 million, Shehab Wire reported. The transaction rescues banks from losses but merely changes the creditor's name, leaving workers' obligations intact, according to the report.

Employees in Gaza remain indebted despite the government purchase, with their legitimate claims awaiting fair settlement. The deal does not resolve the underlying financial crisis or provide relief to public sector workers whose salaries have been withheld.

title: Ramallah buys Gaza employee debts, leaving workers still indebted
